cards.title: Every element is a box
cards.body: `padding` is the space inside a box, around its content. `margin` is the space outside it.
cards.code: I have padding.

cards.title: Borders and corners
cards.body: `border` draws an edge, like `2px solid black`. `border-radius` rounds the corners.
cards.code: Rounded box

check.question: Which property adds space inside a box, around its content?
check.explanation: `padding` is inside the edge. `margin` is outside it, and `border` is the edge itself.

exercise.prompt: Style the `.card` box: a `padding` of `16px` and a `border-radius` of `8px`.
